question: RULE on DRC-4029: cancel it, or send it back? Triage recommends CANCELLATION. Rather than testing a fourth candidate statistic one at a time, it measured the ceiling on every statistic the ruling permits: an oracle assuming perfect estimates and total coverage had a median lead of 1m16s over 375 multi-session instants and never once reached the twenty-minute window this item was scored on. The strongest genuinely-open candidate — the settled minimum plus a suppression rule — was built and measured and failed on both axes at once. Approving authorizes implementation to rewrite the DRC-4029 body, move it to Canceled, correct the milestone, and change one sentence on DRC-4272. Rejecting sends it back to triage with your asks.

artifacts.summary: Recommendation is cancellation, on five ranked reasons, with a reopening condition written as a re-runnable probe rather than a judgement a later reader must trust. The decisive move was to stop testing candidates and measure the bound they all share: every statistic DEC-7 permits makes the claim "nothing you can predict will be ready before X", which is sound only if X is no later than the true soonest completion. A new probe, drc-4029/probe_min_lead.py, measured that ceiling with an oracle assuming perfect estimates and total coverage — median lead 1m16s at k>=2, and 0 of 375 instants reaching twenty minutes. The strongest remaining candidate, the settled minimum plus a suppression rule that renders only when the window is worth leaving on, was built and measured on the same instants: at T=20m it rendered 0 of 375 times, at T=10m it rendered 3 times and reality beat it 3 times by a median of 10m42s, and at T=5m it rendered 6.9% of the time and was wrong 88% of those. Rare and wrong at once is the combination that cannot be tuned out. Three further candidates were recorded as considered and rejected on what the number would say rather than how often. Two second-order findings: the item degrades as the product improves, because a minimum over more rows is smaller, so B2 landing makes D6 less useful rather than more; and where the statistic does work, at one session, it duplicates the card own ~Xm left (est). Six passages in the current body that the ruling or DRC-4271 falsified are corrected in the drafted rewrite, four more than the dispatch named. Evidence was exercised rather than asserted: DRC-4271 own probe was re-run unchanged and reproduces, with one figure reported as drifted rather than repeated — the k=3-4 median understatement is 6m52s on today store against the 9m50s the ruling quotes, same direction and order. Code claims were re-checked at v0.17.1 after main moved. Nothing written to Linear. The knock-on to D5 needs one sentence changed on DRC-4272, not a filing, and is reserved for the captain; the assessment also records that two of D5 three cancellation reasons survive and that DEC-7 constrains D5 harder than D6.
